GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Thank you
   C. Good night
   D. Please

2. When practising Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading comprehension.

3. When practising Extensive reading Scanning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading Scanning.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading Scanning.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading Scanning.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading Scanning.

4. When practising Intensive Reading Skimming, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading Skimming.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading Skimming.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading Skimming.

5. When practising Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

6. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Wasser
   B. Buch
   C. Haus
   D. Schule

7. When practising Intensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading.

8. When practising Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Public speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Public speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Public speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public speaking.

9. When practising Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

10. When practising Listening comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.

11. When practising Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.

12. When practising Listening for details Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for details Conversational skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for details Conversational skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for details Conversational skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Conversational skills.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Directions and locations ● Articles in the Nominative, Accusative and Dative cas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conjunctions and Verbs ● Conjunctive adverbs dann, danach.... ● Conjunctions ● M and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Language Structures 1. Dative verbs (gut/schlecht - gehen, weh tun, empfehlen, g and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Language Structures ● Verbs with separable and inseparable prefixes ● Prepositio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Language Structures ● Reported Speech ● Demonstrative articles, dieser, diese, d and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Listening comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Good day / hello

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading comprehension.

3. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading Scanning.

4. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.

5. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

6. D — Schule

8. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public speaking.

10. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.

11. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Directions and locations ● Articles in the Nominative, Accusative and Dative cas; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Structures ● Verbs with separable and inseparable prefixes ● Prepositio; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

17. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Structures ● Reported Speech ● Demonstrative articles, dieser, diese, d; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

18. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Listening comprehension; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
